author: k29t59dh, mrplow
description: Normalizes audio in a single pass: skips streams already AAC mono/stereo (unless force re-encode is enabled), encodes non-AAC mono/stereo streams to AAC with loudnorm, and downmixes any stream with more than 2 channels to stereo AAC with loudnorm. Caps sample rate at 48kHz, leaves lower rates untouched. Optional force re-encode mode measures loudness on already-compliant streams and only re-encodes if they're off-target.
name: AAC Stereo Downmix Skip 2ch
